title: Coverage Classes and Plan Requirement Matrix for Referrals and Authorizations
content:
This matrix sets, for each **Referrals and Authorizations** type, which services the authorization covers, under which plans it is required, what follows when the service is received without it, and the cost-share treatment of services it covers.

## Matrix

| Authorization type | Services covered | Required under | Received without it under TRICARE Prime | Received without it under TRICARE Select and the premium-based plans | Cost-share treatment of covered services |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | specialty care visits, ambulatory surgery, laboratory and X-ray | TRICARE Prime | point-of-service charges | not required | plan cost share applies and point-of-service is avoided |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | rehabilitative therapy visits | TRICARE Prime | point-of-service charges | not required | plan cost share applies and point-of-service is avoided |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | durable medical equipment | TRICARE Prime | point-of-service charges | not required | plan cost share applies |
| Home Health Care Authorization | home health visits | TRICARE Prime, TRICARE Select and the premium-based plans | denied | denied | plan cost share applies |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | applied behavior analysis | TRICARE Prime, TRICARE Select and the premium-based plans | denied | denied | plan cost share applies |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | skilled nursing facility care | TRICARE Prime, TRICARE Select and the premium-based plans | denied | denied | plan cost share applies |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | inpatient mental health admissions | TRICARE Prime, TRICARE Select and the premium-based plans | denied | denied | plan cost share applies |

The premium-based plans are the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans.

## Services that never need an authorization

For every authorization type the same service classes are exempt: **preventive care, emergency room visits, urgent care visits and individual outpatient behavioral health visits**. None of them needs a referral or authorization of any type.

## Points of reading

- "Not required" in the TRICARE Select column means the type is not needed under TRICARE Select or the premium-based plans; the first three types are required under TRICARE Prime only.
- The last four types are required under all three plan families, and care received without them is denied under each.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

| Hypothetical service | Plan | Type that would cover it | Without it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ambulatory surgery | TRICARE Prime | Specialty Care Referral | point-of-service charges |
| Ambulatory surgery | TRICARE Select | Specialty Care Referral | not required |
| Home health visit | TRICARE Select | Home Health Care Authorization | denied |
| Urgent care visit | TRICARE Prime | none; the class is exempt | not applicable |
